top_signals.title: Russia's internet shutdowns disrupt warnings about incoming drone attacks
top_signals.summary: Russia’s growing restrictions on mobile internet and cellular service are making it harder for people to receive warnings about incoming Ukrainian drone and missile attacks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Flight disruptions ease at Newark, Philadelphia airports following equipment outage
top_signals.summary: Flight delays continued Tuesday but were far fewer compared with Monday, when an FAA flight data system failed and a damaged cable severed a backup system.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
